nodes.label: Fully Manual Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: The project deliberately uses no DI framework (no Hilt/Dagger/Koin) and no Room/SQL; a single hand-written AppContainer builds every repository/engine/controller as a lazy singleton, keeping the dependency graph explicit and framework-free.

nodes.label: Duplicate-Detection Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Staged cost model: cheap size bucketing first, then partial hashing (QuickHasher) to prune, then full streamed hashing (StreamingHasher) only on survivors — minimizing IO on large media libraries.

nodes.label: Dual Perceptual Hash Agreement
nodes.rationale: Two independent perceptual hashes (DHash + average hash) are computed per image and BOTH must agree within Hamming-distance thresholds before clustering near-duplicates, specifically to avoid false positives in SIMILAR/VERY_SIMILAR/DEEP scan modes.

nodes.label: Safety-First Deletion
nodes.rationale: Files are moved to a UUID-named recycle bin (30-day retention) or archived to a dated ZIP before originals are removed; each file's outcome is atomic so one failure never aborts the batch — protecting users from irreversible data loss.

nodes.label: Foreground Services Own Long-Running Work
nodes.rationale: Scan and delete work is owned by foreground services with controller singletons in AppContainer so long-running operations survive Activity lifecycle; ViewModels are thin observers of the controllers rather than owners of the work.

nodes.label: Magic-Byte File Type Verification
nodes.rationale: File type is verified from magic bytes rather than trusted from file extensions, defending against misnamed or spoofed files entering the duplicate-detection pipeline.
